description: This file contains implementation of a generic storage class 'TableExampleStorage' and associated factory and extension methods for setting up storage with dependency injection in Orleans framework. It defines storage management, lifecycle participation, and factory creation patterns.

classes.name: TableExampleStorage`1
classes.description: A generic storage implementation that manages state, participates in grain lifecycle events, and provides save/load operations.

classes.name: TableExampleStorageFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create instances of TableExampleStorage with dependency injection and context configuration.

classes.name: TableExampleStorageExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for ISiloBuilder to configure and add TableExampleStorage services.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Asynchronously completes without performing any real save operation.

methods.name: GetExtendedInfo
methods.description: Returns a string with the storage's name, whether activation was called, and the type of the stored state.

methods.name: LoadState
methods.description: Marks the storage as activated; intended to load persisted state (currently a stub).

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the storage to the grain lifecycle events for setup.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets configuration parameters for the storage.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a storage instance based on the specified configuration and context.

methods.name: UseTableExampleStorage
methods.description: Adds and configures the TableExampleStorage services within the silo builder.
